verdicts.reason: Flags §3 and limits permitted recipients to those needing to know and bound by written confidentiality obligations at least as protective.
Replaces the two-year term with five years and continues trade-secret obligations for as long as information remains a trade secret.
Flags the prohibited non-solicitation clause and replaces §8 with an intentional omission.
Identifies both missing provisions and accepts §1, but expressly declines to treat all of §10 as compliant, leaving forum selection unassessed.
Presents a draft for attorney review, disclaims legal advice, defers judgment calls to supervising counsel, and invents no authorities or citations.
